priority_decision: Detector-only: same-cache diagnostic mean40 headroom is non-flat; offline feedforward deferred. No new control candidates.
prior_exposure: Prior official scalar tables and D4 cause cache are exposed; no old official/holdout trace analysis. D4 is a finite exposed development benchmark, not independent efficacy.
references: Gibbs and Candes, NeurIPS 2021; Zaffran et al., ICML 2022 (calibration motivation, no conformal guarantee)

monitor.score: isotropic norm of XY wrench minus fixed R1 numpy predictor
monitor.predictor: R1 weights, mean, scale remain byte-identical; recompute current residual if original gated branch is inactive because last_error is stale there
monitor.phase_source: coarse public trajectory waypoints; not per-ms/mass/COM/direction lookup
monitor.active_policy: active families require outside_table_height_band, reset when false. PHASE family ungated, reset at each coarse phase boundary.
monitor.cusum: S=max(0,S+(score-location)/scale-drift), sample units; no online parameter adaptation
monitor.OR: call unchanged R1 Detector.update exactly once, preserve residual and all shared/controller state; return old flag OR owned monitor. Never write shared/ctrl state; no I/O or RNG at runtime.
monitor.stability: No feedback path is modified. All old poles are identical if physical/shared-state parity holds; finite noninterference proof, not global stability or real safety guarantee.

calibration.fit_rule: median location; max(1.4826*median absolute deviation,0.25N) scale, global active or fixed five phases; W40 uses no fit statistics
calibration.threshold_rule: 1.05 * maximum unthresholded episode statistic over NEW calibration normals + 1e-9; strict greater-than. For phase family one threshold per coarse phase. Never copy diagnostic D4 thresholds.
calibration.audit_rule: Preserve unchanged R1 flags; examine candidate_extra (not total OR): no extra candidate true sample or rise on any normal audit. One registered new-normal recalibration only before ANY collision or otherwise reject.
calibration.pre_collision_commit: Commit calibration artifact, exact generated candidate sources and parameters, normal audit and tests BEFORE the first collision/validation episode.

redesign.allowed: One normal-only recalibration before any collision using seed371202 and 371203; or one detector structural redesign after validation ONLY if causal implementation evidence identifies a bug/mechanism, with new protocol addendum and fresh validation seed371212. No blind tuning/grid expansion.

detector_gates.perturb_reference_FA_vs_matched_R1: no increase per case and total; physical subset and fresh noise subset reported separately
detector_gates.selection: Architecture independent; every preceding gate required. Choose among eligible per mode by development additional detected, then D4 additional detected, then lower maximum per-case measured p99, then protocol order. No runner-up promotion after holdout.
detector_gates.diagnostic_advancement: ALL four configurations receive fresh validation/development and D4/perturb replay even if permanently disqualified at a prior stage. Immediately record permanent non-adoption; diagnostic improvements cannot revive them or enter selection ranking.
detector_gates.control_scope: No control candidates; inherited control/stability/saturation gates are equality/noninterference checks, not a new control-gain claim.

G4.applies_to: positive masses, specifically final 8kg A/B; failure remains failure

timing.metric: paired controller+detector wall/thread CPU including allocation; guard outside measured methods

relative_R1_interpretation.source: R1 also failed some R3 forced local and D4 saturation gates, so predeclare relative interpretation without changing numeric thresholds.
relative_R1_interpretation.R1_passing_points: candidate must pass original numeric gate
relative_R1_interpretation.R1_failing_points: must not be worse than paired R1
relative_R1_interpretation.FD: identical unchanged closed loop; no altered control candidate. Existing finite R3 results retained, not a new guarantee

timing.metric: paired controller+detector wall/thread CPU including allocation; guard outside measured methods

cache_reuse.D4: R3 R1 385 rows/mode with exact source/condition/raw SHA, current allowed observations only; recompute each candidate monitor and evaluator, prove fresh full-loop online/offline parity and physical bit identity first. Label cached replay, never fresh independent efficacy.
cache_reuse.physical_perturb: Same frozen private matrix first25 rows/mode may replay after raw/source SHA and nominal parity. Old9 noise episodes not reused; generate new seeds371401/402/403.
cache_reuse.new_validation_development: fresh R1 plant streams per architecture; detector-only offline monitor replay only after fresh online/noninterference equivalence. Timing full-loop fresh validation for ALL configs, serial.
cache_reuse.fit_signals: estimated_wrench, time, known mass/COM, public reference, gate only; no truth labels/forces/qpos targets

holdout.marker: exclusive fsynced marker before real RNG, after freeze + Git-object verification
holdout.comparison: Chosen candidate and paired frozen R1 in ONE sealed batch; if effective candidate already R1 deduplicate. Report no new detector efficacy test in a fallback-only holdout.
holdout.failure: affected mode becomes frozen R1; no tuning, source edits, threshold edits, replacement, runner-up or second holdout

freeze.mutable_alias_exception: Only on adoption assemble my_detector.py from frozen standalone mode-specific candidates BEFORE freeze. Old R3 my_detector bytes remain in r1_detector and baseline Git object; all other100 R3 paths stay exact. If no adoption all101 remain exact. R3 freeze itself never edited.
freeze.fallback: Post-failure only output assembly of already-frozen R1 bytes is allowed; no scientific source/threshold/model changes or alternative promotion.

official.stage: LAST after new R4 holdout; one A+B default-name unchanged-kit batch; regression only
official.prior_exposure: regression only, never independent efficacy or fit
official.after_failure: immutable R1 fallback only; no repair, retune, alternate promotion or retest

stop: new local public commit above public baseline; before push
